gloss: comfort (of a place); how comfortable one feels somewhere

definitions.gloss: comfort (of a place); feeling of ease in an environment
definitions.explanation: How comfortable or at ease one feels in a particular place or environment.

examples.japanese: このカフェは{居心地|いごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This café has a comfortable atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {居心地|いごこち}の{悪|わる}い{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: It's an uncomfortable place to be.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{家|いえ}は{居心地|いごこち}が{良|よ}くて{長居|ながい}してしまった。
examples.english: His house was so comfortable that I ended up staying longer than planned.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{居|い}る (to be, to stay) + {心地|ここち} (feeling, sensation) → feeling while being somewhere

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{居心地|いごこち}がいい / {良|よ}い (comfortable, cozy)
・{居心地|いごこち}が{悪|わる}い (uncomfortable, awkward)
・{居心地|いごこち}のいい{場所|ばしょ} (a comfortable place)

RELATED ～{心地|ごこち} WORDS:
・{寝心地|ねごこち} (sleeping comfort)
・{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち} (ride comfort)
・{着心地|きごこち} (wearing comfort)
・{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち} (ease of use)

USAGE NOTE:
{居心地|いごこち} can describe both physical comfort and the social/emotional atmosphere of a place. {居心地|いごこち}が{悪|わる}い may indicate feeling unwelcome or out of place.
